sub_strands.name: Our School
performance_indicators: Identify and name key features within the school compound.
Demonstrate care for school property and the immediate classroom environment.
Observe safety rules while moving around the school compound.

sub_strands.name: Weather and Water
performance_indicators: Identify different weather conditions (sunny, rainy, windy) through observation.
State simple uses of water at home and at school.
Demonstrate proper habits of conserving water such as closing taps.

sub_strands.name: Plants and Animals
performance_indicators: Identify common plants and flowers within the school vicinity.
Recognize and name common domestic animals in the locality.
Demonstrate care and kindness towards animals by avoiding harming them.

sub_strands.name: Personal Cleanliness
performance_indicators: Demonstrate the correct steps of washing hands with soap and flowing water.
Identify personal items used for grooming such as combs and handkerchiefs.
Practice basic habits of keeping their body and clothes clean.

sub_strands.name: Drawing and Coloring
performance_indicators: Draw simple shapes and forms freely using a variety of mediums.
Color within outlined boundaries using crayons, chalk, or charcoal.
Express individual feelings and ideas through freehand drawing.

sub_strands.name: Modeling and Manipulation
performance_indicators: Roll, pinch, and squeeze plasticine or clay to form simple shapes.
Create recognizable patterns by tearing and pasting colored paper leaves.

sub_strands.name: Singing and Rhythm
performance_indicators: Sing simple songs and rhymes in tune and with appropriate expressions.
Clap or stamp feet to match a steady rhythmic beat or tempo.
Perform basic singing games cooperatively with peers.

sub_strands.name: Self and Others
performance_indicators: Demonstrate basic positive values such as sharing, honesty, and kindness.
Identify and practice behaviors that promote harmony with classmates.
Respond positively to mentorship and foundational character guidance.

sub_strands.name: Sorting and Grouping
performance_indicators: Sort concrete objects based on a single attribute such as color.
Group objects based on a single attribute such as size.
Group items based on their shapes in the immediate environment.

sub_strands.name: Matching and Pairing
performance_indicators: Match similar objects found in the classroom or immediate surroundings.
Pair objects that naturally go together from day-to-day context.
Appreciate orderliness when matching and pairing items.

sub_strands.name: Ordering
performance_indicators: Arrange concrete objects in ascending order based on size.
Arrange concrete objects in descending order based on size.
Identify the smallest and largest objects within a collection.

sub_strands.name: Patterns
performance_indicators: Identify simple repeating patterns using concrete materials.
Make simple patterns using two attributes such as color or size.
Extend an ongoing simple pattern using physical cut-outs.

sub_strands.name: Rote Counting
performance_indicators: Rote count numbers sequence from 1 to 9.
Rote count numbers sequence from 1 up to 20.
Participate in singing number rhymes and number songs.

sub_strands.name: Counting Concrete Objects
performance_indicators: Count concrete objects up to 5 through one-to-one correspondence.
Count concrete objects up to 9 through one-to-one correspondence.
Demonstrate order and precision when counting items.

sub_strands.name: Number Recognition
performance_indicators: Recognize and name number symbols from 1 up to 5.
Recognize and name number symbols from 6 up to 9.
Match number symbols with the corresponding number of concrete items.

sub_strands.name: Number Value
performance_indicators: Represent number values using concrete objects from 1 to 5.
Represent number values using concrete objects from 6 to 9.
Link abstract number symbols to practical quantities in their environment.

sub_strands.name: Common Sounds
performance_indicators: Listen carefully to and identify common sounds in the immediate environment.
Distinguish between different sounds made by familiar animals.
Mimic and reproduce familiar sounds heard in school and at home.

sub_strands.name: Listening for Information
performance_indicators: Listen attentively and respond appropriately to simple commands.
Listen and follow two-step instructions given by the teacher.
Demonstrate active listening cues during simple classroom storytelling.

sub_strands.name: Self-Expression
performance_indicators: Express basic needs, personal feelings, and thoughts clearly.
State their own name, age, and gender confidently.
Pronounce basic vocabulary words correctly when talking about themselves.

sub_strands.name: Conversation
performance_indicators: Engage in brief conversations with peers and teachers during activities.
Use polite words and phrases like 'please', 'thank you', and 'sorry'.
Take turns while speaking during group activities or discussions.

sub_strands.name: Book Handling
performance_indicators: Hold a book upright and turn pages carefully from right to left.
Demonstrate left-to-right progression when scanning across a page.
Recognize the differences between the front cover and back cover of a book.

sub_strands.name: Visual Discrimination
performance_indicators: Differentiate between similar and contrasting pictures or symbols.
Match identical shapes, letters, and simple pictorial cards.
Track moving objects visually across a horizontal plane.

sub_strands.name: Fine Motor Skills
performance_indicators: Manipulate plasticine, clay, or playdough to strengthen hand muscles.
Tear, crumple, and paste paper patterns onto outlined boundaries.
Coordinate eye-hand movements during simple threading and lacing activities.

sub_strands.name: Scribbling and Dot Joining
performance_indicators: Hold writing tools using a functional pincer or tripod grip.
Scribble freely on paper or a chalkboard using charcoal, crayons, or chalk.
Join dotted lines to trace simple paths and foundational patterns.
